title: The Nutty Professor
tagline: Seconds for everybody. Thirds for Sherman.
about: A kind, heavy-set professor tests his own weight-loss formula and turns into Buddy Love, a slick, cocky alter ego who will not go away.
cue: Pass the fried chicken when talk at the Klump table turns to the calories in the skin.

Crab cakes, Cajun remoulade, lemon.How to make it400g cooked crab meat, picked60g fresh breadcrumbs, plus 60g panko for coating3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise, plus 125g for the remoulade1 egg2 spring onions, finely sliced1 tsp Old Bay or Cajun seasoning1 tbsp capers, chopped1 tbsp Creole or Dijon mustard1 tsp hot sauce1 lemon60ml vegetable oilMix the crab, breadcrumbs, 3 tbsp mayo, egg, spring onion and seasoning gently, and shape into 8 cakes.Coat in the panko and chill for 15 minutes so they hold.Stir the 125g mayo with the capers, mustard, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon for the remoulade.Shallow fry the cakes until deep golden on both sides, about 3 minutes a side.Drain and serve with the remoulade and lemon wedges.Ernie Junior's honey butter cornbreadErnie Junior laughs his dinner out. Skillet cornbread, whipped honey butter.How to make it150g fine cornmeal (polenta)150g plain flour2 tsp baking powder60g caster sugar1 tsp salt2 eggs300ml buttermilk80g butter, melted, plus 80g softened2 tbsp honeyHeat a 25cm cast-iron pan in the oven at 200°C.Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the eggs, buttermilk and melted butter until just combined.Pour into the hot greased pan and bake until golden and springy.Whip the softened butter with the honey and a pinch of salt and serve with the cornbread in wedges.Buttered dinner rollsPass them to Grandma first. Always.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMama Klump's fried chicken with mashThe skin holds all the calories. Buttermilk fried chicken, mash, gravy.How to make it1.2kg chicken thighs and drumsticks, skin on500ml buttermilk2 tsp hot sauce250g plain flour, plus 2 tbsp for the gravy2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder1 tsp cayenne pepper1.5 L vegetable oil, for frying1kg floury potatoes, peeled80g butter125ml milk375ml chicken stockSoak the chicken in the buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 2 hours, or overnight.Mix the flour with the paprika, garlic powder, cayenne and 2 tsp salt, and dredge the chicken twice, pressing it on.Fry in 170°C oil in batches, turning, until deep golden and cooked through, about 14 minutes. Drain on a rack.Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with 60g butter and the hot milk.Cook the remaining butter and 2 tbsp flour, whisk in the stock and simmer to a peppery gravy.Buddy Love's T-bone with baked potatoBuddy orders six T-bones at The Scream. Chargrilled T-bone, loaded potato, creamed spinach.How to make it4 T-bone steaks, about 400g each4 large potatoes2 tbsp olive oil120g sour cream2 tbsp chives, snipped40g butter500g baby spinach1 garlic clove, crushed150ml thickened cream30g parmesan, gratedRub the potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200°C until crisp outside and soft inside.Bring the steaks to room temperature, season well and grill on a very hot barbecue or pan to medium-rare, about 5 minutes a side.Rest the steaks while you wilt the spinach with the butter and garlic, then simmer with the cream and parmesan until thick.Split the potatoes and fill with sour cream and chives, and serve with the steak and spinach.Something SweetRocky Road hot fudge sundaesBuddy's Rocky Road punchline gets Reggie. Rocky road ice cream, hot fudge, peanuts.How to make it1 L chocolate ice cream100g mini marshmallows80g roasted peanuts, chopped150ml thickened cream150g dark chocolate, chopped2 tbsp golden syrup4 maraschino cherriesSoften the ice cream for 10 minutes, fold in half the marshmallows and half the peanuts and refreeze.Heat the cream with the golden syrup until steaming and stir in the chocolate until glossy.Scoop the ice cream into glasses, pour over the hot fudge and finish with the rest of the marshmallows, peanuts and a cherry.To DrinkSherman's blue formula lemonadeSherman tests the formula on himself. Butterfly pea lemonade that changes colour.How to make it2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers750ml boiling water100g caster sugar100ml water4 lemons, juiced250ml soda water1 tray iceSteep the butterfly pea flowers in the boiling water until deep blue, then strain and chill.Simmer the sugar and 100ml water until dissolved and cool.Fill 4 glasses with ice, the blue tea and syrup, then top with soda.Pour in the lemon juice at the table and watch it turn purple.Sweet tea by the pitcherKeep it down, Papa's trying to watch Roseanne.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
